entries.head: hold off

senses.en: to delay doing something

example.en: Let's hold off on the launch until the bug is fixed.
example.zh: 等这个 bug 修好再上线吧。

entries.l1_note: “先不”不是 hold on（那是等一下）；推迟意思是 hold off (on)。

entries.head: put off

senses.en: to change something to a later time

example.en: We put off the meeting until next Tuesday.
example.zh: 我们把会议推到下周二了。

senses.en: to make someone lose interest or feel uncomfortable

example.en: His constant complaining really puts people off.
example.zh: 他没完没了地抱怨，让人很不想接近。

entries.l1_note: “拖延”不是 delay it again；put off 还有“倒胃口、让人反感”这层意思。

entries.head: push back

senses.en: to change an event to a later time

example.en: They pushed the deadline back by a week.
example.zh: 他们把截止日往后推了一周。

entries.l1_note: 推迟时间；bring forward 是提前。

example.en: Can we move the meeting earlier?
example.zh: 会议能提前吗？

entries.head: get around to

senses.en: to finally do something you have been putting off

example.en: I still haven't gotten around to cleaning the fridge.
example.zh: 我一直没腾出时间清理冰箱。

entries.l1_note: “终于有时间做”不是 finally have time；get around to 强调拖了很久。

entries.head: fit in

senses.en: to find time for something in a busy schedule

example.en: I can fit you in at four if that works.
example.zh: 四点我能给你腾出时间，行吗？

senses.en: to feel accepted by a group

example.en: It took a while to fit in at the new office.
example.zh: 我花了一阵子才融入新办公室。

entries.l1_note: “插队加个日程”不是 put you in my time；fit someone in 才是。

entries.head: squeeze in

senses.zh: 时间很紧还塞进一件事
senses.en: to manage to do something even though there is little time

example.en: I squeezed in a quick call between meetings.
example.zh: 我在两个会之间硬塞了个电话。

entries.l1_note: 硬挤时间；fit in 是安排得下。

entries.head: come up

senses.en: when an event is going to happen soon

example.en: The deadline is coming up, so I'm staying late.
example.zh: 截止日快到了，我最近都在加班。

entries.l1_note: “快到了”不是 is coming soon 才自然；日程临近常说 is coming up。

entries.head: set aside

senses.en: to keep time or money for a special purpose

example.en: Set aside an hour every morning for reading.
example.zh: 每天早上留一小时读书。

entries.l1_note: “留时间”不是 leave time（也行）但更常用 set aside；留钱也是它。

entries.head: stick to

senses.en: to continue with a plan or rule without changing it

example.en: I'll stick to water tonight — I have an early meeting.
example.zh: 我今晚就喝水，明天一早有会。

entries.l1_note: 坚持计划；stick with 是坚持不换。

entries.head: sign up for

senses.en: to put your name on a list for a course or activity

example.en: I signed up for a speaking class on Tuesday nights.
example.zh: 我报了个周二晚上的口语课。

entries.l1_note: 报名是 sign up for，不是 apply for（那是正式申请职位/签证）。

entries.head: take up
entries.zh: 开始培养一个爱好；改短（衣服）

senses.en: to start doing an activity regularly

example.en: I took up swimming after my knee started hurting.
example.zh: 膝盖开始疼以后我改练游泳了。

senses.en: to make a piece of clothing shorter

example.en: The tailor took up the sleeves by two centimeters.
example.zh: 裁缝把袖子改短了两厘米。

entries.l1_note: “开始学”不是 start to learn 才自然；开始一项活动常用 take up。

entries.head: take to

senses.en: to start to like something or get good at it quickly

example.en: She took to the guitar faster than anyone expected.
example.zh: 她学吉他快得超出所有人预料。

entries.l1_note: 很快喜欢或上手；get into 是逐渐喜欢。

entries.head: get into
entries.zh: 喜欢上、沉迷；进入；陷入（麻烦）

senses.en: to become interested in something

example.en: I got into baking during the lockdown and never stopped.
example.zh: 封控期间我开始迷上烘焙，一直没停。

senses.en: to enter a place or vehicle

example.en: We got into the car and headed for the airport.
example.zh: 我们上车往机场开。

senses.en: to become involved in a difficult situation

example.en: He got into trouble for missing the safety training.
example.zh: 他因为没参加安全培训惹了麻烦。

entries.l1_note: “入坑”不是 fall into the pit；英语是 get into something。

entries.head: be into

senses.en: to be very interested in something

example.en: I'm really into bouldering these days.
example.zh: 我最近很迷攀岩。

entries.l1_note: “我很喜欢”不是 I very like it（中式）；I'm really into it 才地道。

entries.head: work on

senses.en: to spend time doing or improving something

example.en: I'm working on my pronunciation this month.
example.zh: 我这个月在练发音。

entries.l1_note: “我在练发音”不是 I am practicing pronunciation 才自然；work on 更宽，含改进。

entries.head: plan out

senses.en: to decide all the details of a plan

example.en: We planned out the whole trip in one evening.
example.zh: 我们一个晚上就把行程排好了。

entries.l1_note: 排计划是 plan out；plan 单独是打算。

entries.head: map out

senses.en: to plan something in detail

example.en: She mapped out a weekend route with three stops.
example.zh: 她规划了一条三个点的周末路线。

entries.l1_note: 规划是 map out，带“画出来”的画面。

entries.head: block out

senses.zh: 在日程里留出整块时间
senses.en: to reserve a period of time

example.en: Block out Sunday morning for the gym.
example.zh: 周日早上留出来去健身。

entries.l1_note: 留出整段时间是 block out；set aside 更通用。

entries.head: carve out

senses.en: to find time for something with difficulty

example.en: He carved out an hour for lunch between calls.
example.zh: 他在电话会之间硬挤出一小时吃午饭。

entries.l1_note: 挤出时间是 carve out；不是 squeeze out（那是榨干）。

entries.head: line up

senses.en: to arrange things or people in advance

example.en: I've lined up two friends for Saturday.
example.zh: 周六我已经约好两个朋友了。

entries.l1_note: 安排好是 line up；排队也是 line up（美式）。

entries.head: pencil in

senses.en: to arrange something provisionally

example.en: Let's pencil in Friday and confirm later.
example.zh: 先暂定周五，之后再确认。

entries.l1_note: 暂定是 pencil in，暗示还可能改。

entries.head: book up

senses.en: when everything is already reserved

example.en: The good restaurants are booked up on Saturday.
example.zh: 周六好点的餐厅都订满了。

entries.l1_note: 订满是 be booked up；book 是预订。

entries.head: call off

senses.en: to cancel something planned

example.en: They called off the picnic because of the storm.
example.zh: 因为暴风雨他们把野餐取消了。

entries.l1_note: 取消是 call off；不是 cancel off（中式叠加）。

entries.head: back out

senses.en: to decide not to do something you agreed to

example.en: Two people backed out, so we have extra tickets.
example.zh: 两个人临时不去了，我们多了票。

entries.l1_note: 反悔退出是 back out (of)；不是 cancel by myself。
collocations: back out at the last minute

entries.head: bow out

senses.en: to leave a role or plan politely

example.en: He bowed out of the trip to let someone else go.
example.zh: 他退出这次旅行，把名额让给别人。

entries.l1_note: 体面退出是 bow out；不是 bow down（那是鞠躬/屈服）。

entries.head: meet up

senses.en: to meet someone, usually by arrangement

example.en: Let's meet up at the station at ten.
example.zh: 十点车站在碰头吧。

entries.l1_note: 碰头是 meet up；meet 单独是遇见。

entries.head: round up

senses.en: to gather people together

example.en: Can you round up the usual crowd for Friday?
example.zh: 周五能把常聚的那帮人叫上吗？

entries.l1_note: 召集是 round up；round up 也指把数字取整。

entries.head: free up

senses.zh: 取消安排让时间空出来
senses.en: to make time available

example.en: Canceling the call freed up my afternoon.
example.zh: 那个电话会取消，我下午空出来了。

entries.l1_note: 腾出时间是 free up；free 单独是自由的。

entries.head: roll over

senses.en: to move something to a later date

example.en: The unused days roll over to next month.
example.zh: 没用完的天数顺延到下个月。

entries.l1_note: 顺延是 roll over；roll over 也指翻身、翻车。

entries.head: get together

senses.en: when people meet to spend time together

example.en: Let's get together for hotpot this weekend.
example.zh: 这周末一起聚个餐吃火锅吧。

entries.l1_note: get together 是不及物；约人聚说 get together with friends。

entries.head: miss out

senses.en: to lose a chance to do something

example.en: Don't miss out on the early-bird tickets.
example.zh: 别错过早鸟票。

senses.en: to fail to take part in something enjoyable

example.en: Come to the party — you don't want to miss out.
example.zh: 来参加聚会吧，你可别错过。

entries.l1_note: miss out 常跟 on：miss out on a chance/deal；漏掉某人用 leave out（美式）。

entries.head: stick around

senses.en: to stay in a place for a while

example.en: Stick around after class — a few of us are getting coffee.
example.zh: 下课后别走，我们几个去喝咖啡。

entries.l1_note: stick around 是不及物，口语常用；别写成 stick around somewhere 的正式表达。

entries.head: ask over

senses.en: 请到家里

example.en: We asked the new neighbors over for dinner.
example.zh: 我们请新邻居来家里吃饭。

entries.l1_note: ask someone over 是请到家里；ask for 是请求。

entries.head: blow off
entries.zh: 放（计划、安排的）鸽子；不去、不理

senses.zh: 不去已经约好的事，放鸽子
senses.en: to not do something you had planned or agreed to do

example.en: He blew off our dinner to play games.
example.zh: 他为了打游戏放了我们晚饭的鸽子。

entries.l1_note: blow off 常接事/安排：blow off a meeting / plans。放某人鸽子更常说 stand someone up。

entries.head: bum around

senses.en: 闲逛

example.en: We bummed around the old town all afternoon.
example.zh: 我们整个下午在老城区闲逛。

entries.l1_note: bum around 是闲逛；口语。

entries.head: drop over

senses.en: 过来坐坐

example.en: Drop over for coffee sometime.
example.zh: 改天过来喝杯咖啡。

entries.l1_note: drop over 是过来坐坐；美式口语。

entries.head: invite out

senses.en: 约出去

example.en: He invited her out for dinner.
example.zh: 他约她出去吃饭。

entries.l1_note: invite someone out 是约出去；invite to 是邀请去。

entries.head: kick back

senses.en: 放松

example.en: We kicked back with a movie after work.
example.zh: 下班后我们看电影放松。

entries.l1_note: kick back 是放松；口语。

entries.head: screw around

senses.en: 瞎混

example.en: Stop screwing around and finish your work.
example.zh: 别瞎混了，把活干完。

entries.l1_note: screw around 是瞎混/浪费时间；口语。

entries.head: slip away

senses.en: 悄悄离开

example.en: We slipped away before the speeches started.
example.zh: 演讲开始前我们悄悄走了。

entries.l1_note: slip away 是悄悄离开；不是“滑走”。

entries.head: sneak out

senses.en: 溜出去

example.en: He sneaked out of the party early.
example.zh: 他提前从聚会溜了出去。

entries.l1_note: sneak out 是溜出去；sneak out of + 地方。

entries.head: stand around

senses.en: 干站着

example.en: We stood around waiting for the store to open.
example.zh: 我们干站着等店开门。

entries.l1_note: stand around 是无所事事地站着；不是“站在周围”。

entries.head: swing by

senses.en: 顺路来一下

example.en: I'll swing by after work.
example.zh: 我下班后顺路过来。

entries.l1_note: swing by 是顺路来一下；美式口语。

example.en: I wake up late on Saturdays and make a big breakfast.
example.zh: 周六我睡到很晚，再做顿丰盛的早饭。

example.zh: 我们周五晚上计划周末。

example.en: I look forward to the long weekend all month.
example.zh: 我整个月都盼着这个长周末。

example.en: Let's take a day trip to the lake.
example.zh: 我们去湖边一日游吧。

example.en: We're going on a trip to Yunnan next month.
example.zh: 下个月我们去云南旅行。

example.en: I spend time with my family on Sundays.
example.zh: 周日我陪家人。

example.en: I hung out with friends at the mall.
example.zh: 我和朋友在商场玩。

example.en: We lazed around the apartment all morning.
example.zh: 我们整个上午在屋里懒着。

example.en: I had a slow morning with coffee and a book.
example.zh: 我慢悠悠地喝了咖啡看了书。

example.zh: 周五我们出去吃晚饭吧。

example.zh: 这部电影结局圆满。

example.en: She can't watch a scary movie alone.
example.zh: 她不敢一个人看恐怖片。

example.en: I skip the ads at the beginning.
example.zh: 片头的广告我都跳过。

entries.head: be on the edge of one's seat

example.en: The last ten minutes kept us on the edge of our seats.
example.zh: 最后十分钟紧张得我们坐不住。

example.en: Don't spoil the ending; I haven't seen it.
example.zh: 别剧透，我还没看。

example.en: I watch with subtitles when the accents are heavy.
example.zh: 口音重的时候我看字幕。

example.en: We watched one episode after another until two.
example.zh: 我们一集接一集看到两点。

example.en: I caught up on a show over the holiday.
example.zh: 假期我把一部剧补完了。

example.en: Just one more episode, then I'll sleep.
example.zh: 再看一集就睡。

example.en: I stayed up late finishing the season.
example.zh: 我熬夜把这一季看完了。

example.en: Every episode ends on a cliffhanger.
example.zh: 每集结尾都留悬念。

example.en: We watched the whole season in one weekend.
example.zh: 我们一个周末看完整季。

example.en: It's so good that I can't stop watching.
example.zh: 太好看了，我停不下来。

example.zh: 我一口气看完了这部剧。

example.en: Let's start a new series tonight.
example.zh: 今晚开始追部新剧吧。

example.en: She's hooked on a detective show.
example.zh: 她迷上了一部侦探剧。

example.zh: 我在地铁上听音乐。

example.zh: 戴上耳机，宝宝睡了。

example.en: Turn up the volume; I love this song.

example.zh: 最后一首歌大家一起唱。

example.en: He hummed a tune while cooking.
example.zh: 他做饭时哼着小调。

example.zh: 我为自驾游建了个歌单。

example.en: I put the song on repeat all afternoon.
example.zh: 这首歌我单曲循环了一下午。

entries.head: have a song stuck in one's head

example.en: I have a song stuck in my head all day.
example.zh: 这首歌在我脑子里循环了一天。

example.en: We're going to a concert on Sunday.
example.zh: 周日我们去看演唱会。

example.en: She plays an instrument in the school band.
example.zh: 她在校乐队演奏乐器。

example.en: I read a book before bed every night.
example.zh: 我每晚睡前看书。

example.en: I borrowed a book from the library.
example.zh: 我从图书馆借了本书。

example.en: Return the book by Friday.
example.zh: 周五前还书。

example.en: Turn the page and keep reading.
example.zh: 翻页，继续读。

example.en: I got lost in the book for three hours.
example.zh: 我沉浸在书里三个小时。

example.en: She read the story out loud to the kids.
example.zh: 她给孩子们大声读故事。

entries.head: judge a book by its cover

example.zh: 别以貌取书。

example.zh: 我们在图书馆里找了一小时书。

example.en: You can check out five books at a time.
example.zh: 一次可以借五本书。

example.en: I curled up with a book on the sofa.
example.zh: 我蜷在沙发上看书。

example.en: Let's play a game after dinner.
example.zh: 晚饭后玩个游戏吧。

example.en: He plays video games with his friends online.
example.zh: 他和朋友在线玩电子游戏。

example.en: Roll the dice and move your piece.
example.zh: 掷骰子，走你的棋子。

example.en: Shuffle the cards and deal.
example.zh: 洗牌发牌。

example.en: Take turns; don't grab.
example.zh: 轮流来，别抢。

example.en: It's your turn; make a move.
example.zh: 到你了，走一步。

example.zh: 她下棋很厉害。

example.en: He beat me at chess three times.
example.zh: 他下棋赢了我三次。

example.en: Play fair and don't peek.
example.zh: 公平比赛，别偷看。

example.en: Don't let him win just because he's little.
example.zh: 别因为他是小孩就让着他赢。

example.en: I put on comfortable clothes as soon as I get home.
example.zh: 我一回家就换上舒服的衣服。

example.en: I took a nap after work.
example.zh: 下班后我打了个盹。

example.en: Take a break; you've been working for hours.
example.zh: 休息一下，你都干了好几个小时了。

example.en: We went for a ride along the river.
example.zh: 我们沿河兜了兜风。

example.en: He plays with the kids after dinner.
example.zh: 他晚饭后陪孩子玩。

example.en: I treated myself to a new pair of shoes.
example.zh: 我犒劳自己买了双新鞋。

example.en: Take off your coat and stay for dinner.
example.zh: 脱了外套留下来吃饭吧。

example.en: I took up a hobby to relax.
example.zh: 我培养了个爱好来放松。

example.en: He plays in a band on weekends.
example.zh: 他周末在乐队里玩。

example.en: The kids drew pictures of their pets.
example.zh: 孩子们画了他们的宠物。

example.en: My grandpa collects stamps.
example.zh: 我爷爷集邮。

example.en: She grows flowers on the balcony.
example.zh: 她在阳台上种花。

example.en: I bake bread on Sunday mornings.
example.zh: 我周日早上烤面包。

example.en: We did a puzzle over the weekend.
example.zh: 周末我们拼了拼图。

example.en: Let's go hiking next Saturday.
example.zh: 下周六去徒步吧。

example.en: My dad and I play chess after dinner.
example.zh: 我爸晚饭后和我下棋。

example.en: I take a cooking class on Tuesdays.
example.zh: 我周二上烹饪课。

example.en: Would you like to come to my birthday party?
example.zh: 你想来我的生日聚会吗？

entries.head: do you want to join us

example.en: Do you want to join us for dinner?
example.zh: 想和我们一起吃饭吗？

example.en: Are you free on Saturday for a hike?
example.zh: 周六有空去徒步吗？

example.en: Do you have plans tonight?
example.zh: 今晚有安排吗？

example.en: Bring someone along if you like.
example.zh: 想带朋友就带。

entries.head: we would love to see you

example.en: We would love to see you at the party.
example.zh: 很想在聚会上见到你。

example.en: Save the date for the wedding.
example.zh: 婚礼那天留着。

example.en: I would love to come.
example.zh: 我很乐意来。

example.en: I'm in if it's after six.
example.zh: 六点以后我就去。

example.en: That sounds like fun; let's do it.
example.zh: 听起来很有趣，我们去吧。

example.en: Yes please; I'd love a coffee.
example.zh: 好的谢谢，我想要杯咖啡。

example.en: Great, it's a date.
example.zh: 好，那就说定了。

example.en: I wouldn't miss it for anything.
example.zh: 我怎么样都不会错过。

example.en: What time should I come over?
example.zh: 我几点到？

example.en: I'll be there at seven.
example.zh: 我七点一定到。

example.en: Seven works for me.
example.zh: 七点对我来说可以。

example.en: See you then; I'll bring snacks.
example.zh: 到时候见，我带零食。
